question.text: Per the current Section 111A rate (as revised in 2024 for transfers on or after July 23, 2024), short-term capital gains on listed equity shares/units (on which STT has been paid) sold within 12 months are taxed at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 111A of the Income-tax Act, 1961 was amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 to raise the STCG rate on listed equity (with STT paid) from 15% to 20% for transfers on or after July 23, 2024, plus applicable surcharge and cess. STCG on other capital assets continues to be taxed at applicable slab rates. The Trap: 15% is the pre-July-23-2024 Section 111A rate; 10% is associated with the old listed-equity LTCG regime; the slab rate applies to non-Section-111A STCG. Note: The XIX-A workbook discusses STCG/LTCG characterisation and pass-through taxation generally, and notes that capital-gains tax rates depend on holding period, mode of exit, and listed/unlisted nature. Specific Section 111A rate figures should always be cross-checked against the latest Income-tax Act position — tax rates are volatile.
